FAQ

Does this replace Figma?

No — the Figma components and the code blocks read the same tokens, on purpose.

Can I add a new block?

Drop a file in blocks/, export named variant functions, build.js finds it automatically.

Ready to assemble a page?

Pick a manifest, pick a style pack, run the build.
